scope: Seeded target-free one-shot UI permission classifier
application_examples: Outlook email send and Reply all
meeting invite accept, decline, and cancel
limitations: This is a deterministic target-free classifier benchmark, not a live Teams or Outlook send attempt.
One bounded OCR-like corruption is applied per generated label; arbitrary OCR failure is still fail-closed only when the target remains semantically recognizable.
The benchmark proves the approval gate, not operator identity, two-person approval, or a physical panic-stop drill.
